sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
Understood. I'll keep your grocery budget under $600 a month in any planning I do for you in this session.

I can't save it beyond this session, so if you want it to carry over, add it to a CLAUDE.md file. I can do that if you'd like.

It would help to know your household size and any dietary constraints, since both change what $600 covers. If you want a meal plan or shopping list, say so and I'll build it around that limit. At $600 a month, you have about $20 a day.
